payload.body: Shipped automated a11y + l10n suite locking in FR-101/FR-103 contracts. New: design-web/src/a11y-suite.test.tsx (icon-name contract completeness + both-pack resolution + decorative glyphs; interactive controls keyboard-operable with names/roles/state; focus-visible + reduced-motion CSS contract), protocol/tests/localization-suite.test.ts (no-gaps/no-stale default table, full fallback-chain ordering, interpolation + function messages), strengthened design/tests/a11y.test.ts (contrast-pair integrity across all 12 themes). typecheck exit 0; design 50, design-web 73, protocol l10n 26 green. No new deps.
